WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN "invoice_date" >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND "invoice_date" < DATE '2025-01-01' THEN 'current'
      WHEN "invoice_date" >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND "invoice_date" < DATE '2024-01-01' THEN 'base'
    END AS period,
    SUM("total") AS revenue
  FROM "public"."invoice"
  WHERE "billing_country" = 'USA'
    AND "invoice_date" >= DATE '2023-01-01'
    AND "invoice_date" < DATE '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  c.revenue AS current_revenue,
  b.revenue AS base_revenue,
  CASE WHEN b.revenue IS NULL OR b.revenue = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE (c.revenue - b.revenue) / b.revenue * 100 END AS yoy_growth_rate_pct
FROM yearly c
CROSS JOIN yearly b
WHERE c.period = 'current' AND b.period = 'base'
